item.title: Charge dispersion
item.description: Charge dispersion In superconducting qubits, the fermionic parity leads to distinct energy levels across the Josephson junction, resulting in a frequency splitting between the two parity states—an effect known as charge dispersion.

item.title: Cooper pair
item.description: Cooper pair Cooper pair consists of two electrons with opposite spins, and can be regarded as a boson that follows the Bose-Einstein distribution.

item.title: Vortex

item.title: Quasiparticle
